description: moyai 舫い — a VERIFIED proof-of-contribution that MINTS non-monetary reciprocity credit (ADR-2606062100). A donated node (ameno browser / e7m CLI / kotoba pod, ADR-2606012100) contributed inference/compute to the Murakumo commons; a fraction of the batch was honeypot/spot-checked against frozen-edge-model answers on pinned core nodes, and ONLY verified, non-duplicate work mints credit (proof_of_contribution.py). This credit is the 'reward for participating in inference' — but it is structurally NOT money, NOT income, NOT a benefit, and does NOT touch Basic High Income: it is a give-to-get use-right on the commons itself (情報を得るには情報を生成する; the 入会権 / iriai-ken commons-use-right model, ADR-2605192345). It is the charter-clean carve-out to ADR-2606012100 G4 (compute donation grants no benefit): a draw-right on the same scarce resource you helped produce is reciprocity, not welfare, so anti-class / cash≡0 / 1-SBT-1-vote all stand. The five const fields below are the on-chain proof of those invariants. Aggregate-friendly, no donor PII beyond the contributing DID; never published as a per-donor leaderboard (anti-class).

contributorDid.description: DID of the contributing node (donor DID or ephemeral node DID). The credit is bound to THIS identity and is non-transferable (transferable=false), so sybil identities cannot pool credit. No-server-key: the node co-signs this attestation; the server cannot mint unilaterally (ADR-2605231525).

nodeClass.description: Which donated-node form did the work (ADR-2606012100 §3).

period.description: Accounting period (e.g. ISO date / epoch range) over which the contribution was verified and credit minted. Drives the per-identity earn-rate cap.

verifiedInferenceUnits.description: Reference inference-token-equivalent units that PASSED verification (honeypot + spot-check, non-duplicate). Integer-with-implied-units (ADR-2605190900). Only verified work counts — a fabricated batch verifies to 0.

honeypotPassRatePermille.description: Pass rate on honeypot + spot-check jobs, per-mille. A mint requires 1000 (all checked jobs correct) — all-or-nothing batch slashing. Below 1000 ⇒ batch slashed, mintedCredits=0, node cooled down.

mintedCredits.description: moyai credit units actually minted = min(verified units × mint-ratio, earn-rate-cap headroom). Burned later (drawReceipt) to draw discretionary surplus inference. Decays with a half-life (anti-hoarding) — a flow, never a hoardable store of wealth/power.

redeemableUsdMicros.description: INVARIANT, always 0. moyai credit is non-monetary: it can NEVER be sold, cashed out, or counted as income. Its presence as a const-0 field is the on-chain proof that cash≡0 (N1) holds and that this reward does NOT affect Basic High Income (the explicit design constraint).

transferable.description: INVARIANT, always false. Credit is bound to contributorDid and cannot be transferred, gifted, merged, or pooled (the ledger exposes no such operation). This is the structural anti-sybil property: splitting work across identities yields un-recombinable, individually-capped balances.

affectsBasicHighIncome.description: INVARIANT, always false. The user-mandated firewall: moyai NEVER affects Basic High Income. Every member gets an unconditional subsistence inference floor (information-as-BHI) regardless of credit; credit only governs discretionary surplus under mesh contention.

grantsGovernanceWeight.description: INVARIANT, always false. moyai credit buys no governance power; 1 SBT = 1 vote is untouched (anti-class).

grantsBenefitOrStage.description: INVARIANT, always false. moyai credit is NEVER a path to Liberation-Ladder advancement, welfare benefits, or priority over others for benefits (ADR-2605261000 N2/N3; the ADR-2606012100 G4 carve-out is scoped strictly to commons-draw-rights). Drawing surplus inference is using the commons, not receiving a benefit.

verificationEvidenceRef.description: Optional AT URI of the verification record (honeypot set + spot-check results) for audit. The mint is replayable from the immutable kotoba Datom log.

createdAt.description: When the contribution was attested + minted.
